scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.cdk:synth: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk synth
scripts.cdk:synth:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: npm run build:prod && export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval broadening -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:destroy:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:destroy:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:diff:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk diff -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:diff:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk diff -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:bootstrap: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk bootstrap
